book.summary: Workplace Software and Skills is designed to flexibly support a range of courses covering computer literacy, Microsoft Office, and Google Suite applications. The textbook covers both hard and soft skills that are applicable to a broad range of academic majors and careers. Workplace Software and Skills leverages complementary product features in spreadsheet, word processing, presentation, and similar applications.
